items.text: Sober spaces
Sober space: every closed irreducible subset has exactly one generic point.
\widetilde X\ =\ \{\text{closed irreducible subsets of } X\}\ \ \text{(sobrification)},\qquad \operatorname{Top}(\widetilde X)\simeq\operatorname{Top}(X)
Serre's spaces (maximal ideals of a finitely generated $k$-algebra) are not sober; Hausdorff spaces and schemes are.
Closed sets of a space of ideals: $V(S)=\{\mathfrak p\ \text{of the type considered}:\ \mathfrak p\supset S\}$ as basic closed sets; finite unions, arbitrary intersections.
Specialization: $x\in\overline{\{y\}}$ is an order relation, not in general an equivalence.
Tensor product of sheaves of modules
U\mapsto M(U)\otimes_K N(U)\ \ \text{a presheaf};\quad M\otimes N=\text{its associated sheaf}
It solves the universal problem of bilinear pairings (SGA 4, sheaves of modules).
N=K^n:\quad (M\otimes N)(U)=M(U)^n\ \ \text{(presheaf and sheaf tensor products agree)}
Same for $N$ free, $K^{(I)}$, and for $N$ projective of finite type (direct factor of $K^n$, projector tensored with the identity).
Algebras as filtered limits
$K=\varinjlim K_i$, $K_i$ of finite type over $\mathbf Z$; $A$ of finite presentation over $K$: $A=A_i\otimes_{K_i}K$ for $i$ large.

(EGA IV, limits) A property of the fibres holds for $A$ over $K$ iff it holds for $A_j$ over $K_j$, $j\ge i$: geometrically connected or irreducible or normal fibres, non-empty fibres, surjective, flat, smooth, étale, unramified.
$A$ of finite presentation and flat over $K$: comes from a flat $A_i$ of finite type over $\mathbf Z$.
The two basic types of topoi
\operatorname{Top}(X)\quad\text{and}\quad\widehat C=\operatorname{Hom}(C^\circ,\mathbf{Sets})\quad(C\ \text{small})
Points of $\widehat C$
C\to\operatorname{Points}(\widehat C),\quad X\mapsto(F\mapsto F(X))\ \ \text{fully faithful}
Filtering direct limits of fibre functors are fibre functors.
C\hookrightarrow\operatorname{Pro}(C)\ \xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }\ \operatorname{Points}(\widehat C)
Essential point: fibre functor commuting with arbitrary inverse limits $\iff$ direct factor of a representable (image of a projector in $C$).
\widehat C\simeq\operatorname{Top}(X)\ \Longrightarrow\ C\ \text{is an ordered category}
Ordered category: at most one arrow between two objects; $X\le Y\iff\exists\,X\to Y$; strictly ordered if isomorphic objects are equal.
Conversely: $C$ ordered $\Longrightarrow$ $\widehat C\simeq\operatorname{Top}(X)$.
Open sets from the subobjects $U$ of the final object $e$ of $\widehat C$:
C_U=\{X\in C:\ X\to e\ \text{factors through } U\},\qquad Y\le X\in C_U\Rightarrow Y\in C_U
\text{opens of } C=\{O\subset C:\ X\in O,\ Y\le X\Rightarrow Y\in O\}\quad(\text{sieves})
\operatorname{Sub}(e)\ \leftrightarrow\ \{\text{sieves}\},\quad \sup\leftrightarrow\cup,\quad \text{finite }\cap\leftrightarrow\cap
\text{smallest open set containing } x:\quad O_x=\{y\in C:\ y\le x\}
